logline: In the aftermath of the brutal attack, Alexander repairs Juliana's devastated garden and swears to protect her with his life, drawing them into a tender, intimate embrace by the hearth.
continuity_notes: Picks up the morning after Episode 16's moonlit confrontation where Alexander defended Juliana and defeated Harrington's hired thugs in her medicinal garden.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: High angle wide shot looking down at the muddy, trampled garden. Broken wooden planters and splintered planks litter the ground as Juliana kneels amidst the ruined soil.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana sits on her knees in her dirt-smudged dress, her hands wrapped in clean linen bandages, sorrowfully examining the wreckage. In the distant background, Alexander paces near the perimeter fence.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Juliana's bandaged hand reaching into the dark earth of a battered planter box.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana gently lifts a tiny, delicate white daisy clinging to its exposed roots out of the soil, cupping it in her palm.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up tilting up to Juliana's face, bruised and tear-streaked yet filled with fragile hope.

events.label: JULIANA (Soft, Emotional)
events.content: "Some of them survived."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle medium shot of Alexander repairing the broken wooden fence with a heavy iron hammer.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Rhythmic, heavy thuds of an iron hammer pounding into weathered wood.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander firmly drives nails into a fractured fence post, his brow furrowed with focused determination.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot framing Juliana kneeling on the wet cobblestones in the foreground while Alexander stands by the fence behind her, lowering his hammer.

events.label: JULIANA (Grateful, Sincere)
events.content: "Thank you."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Alexander turning toward her, his scarred face stoic and intense.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Gruff, Low)
events.content: "For what?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana looking up at him with deep emotional vulnerability, her eyes shimmering with tears.

events.label: JULIANA (Trembling, Heartfelt)
events.content: "For standing between me and those men."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Alexander, his piercing blue-grey eyes fixed upon her with absolute conviction.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Unwavering, Firm)
events.content: "I would do it again."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana, her lips parting as her voice wavers with emotion.

events.label: JULIANA (Whispering, Awed)
events.content: "Even if there were ten of them?"

events.label: ALEXANDER (Deep, Resolute)
events.content: "As long as I draw breath..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tracking shot following Alexander as he strides across the muddy garden and approaches Juliana.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, gently taking her trembling, bandaged hands into his large, weathered palms.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Gentle, Vowing)
events.content: "...no one will hurt you again."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Juliana's tear-filled face, overwhelmed by his fierce devotion.

events.label: JULIANA (Choked Up, Pained)
events.content: "You cannot promise that."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up of Alexander's intense, protective gaze locking onto hers.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Quiet, Absolute)
events.content: "I just did."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of their joined hands, his rugged, scarred fingers wrapping securely around her bandaged fingers.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander squeezes Juliana's hands reassuringly as she rests her fingertips against his skin. The scene fades to black.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot in the warm, flickering firelight of the stone cottage. Juliana kneels on the stone floor beside a washbasin of water while Alexander sits quietly in a chair beside the blazing hearth.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana wrings out a clean linen cloth from the basin and tenderly dabs at the fresh cuts and abrasions on the back of Alexander's right hand.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands delicately pressing the white cloth against Alexander's wounded knuckles.

events.label: JULIANA (Tender, Reproachful)
events.content: "You were bleeding last night."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up showing Alexander gazing down at her, his expression softening with unspoken affection as he gently takes hold of her wrist.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Quiet, Fond)
events.content: "So were you."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes, a faint, tender smile gracing her lips.

events.label: JULIANA (Softly Teasing)
events.content: "You make it very difficult to argue with you."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Alexander ducking his chin, a subtle, bashful smile fleetingly touching his scarred face.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana returns the damp cloth to the ceramic basin, her expression turning somber and reflective.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her vulnerability resurfacing in the warm amber glow.

events.label: JULIANA (Vulnerable, Sincere)
events.content: "I was frightened."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Alexander, his brow furrowing with sudden concern.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Questioning)
events.content: "Of them?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana gazing directly into his eyes, her heart laid bare.

events.label: JULIANA (Whispering, Earnest)
events.content: "Of losing you."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Alexander visibly moved, his gaze softening with profound emotion.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot as Alexander stands and pulls Juliana gently to her feet against his broad chest.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana rests her cheek against Alexander's chest, closing her eyes as his strong arms wrap around her shoulders, holding her safe against his frame.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on their faces nestled together in the firelight, Alexander resting his bearded chin against her hair.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana nestles deeper into his coat, listening intently to the rapid thudding beneath his chest.

events.label: JULIANA (Soft, Playful)
events.content: "Your heart is racing."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Alexander tilting his head down toward her, a tender smile breaking through his rugged beard.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Warm, Whispering)
events.content: "So is yours."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot framing the couple embraced in front of the roaring, glowing fireplace.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana slowly raises her hand, gently twirling a lock of Alexander's long, unruly dark hair between her fingers.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of her delicate fingers running through his thick strands of hair.

events.label: JULIANA (Lighthearted, Teasing)
events.content: "This is becoming impossible."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana beaming up at him with affectionate humor.

events.label: JULIANA (Smiling)
events.content: "Soon birds will start nesting in it."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Alexander regarding her with a subtle, affectionate smirk.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Dry, Amused)
events.content: "They have not complained yet."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana lets out a quiet, melodic laugh.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up as Juliana lifts her bandaged hand toward his beard playfully.

events.label: JULIANA (Charming, Tender)
events.content: "Then I shall have to save you from the birds."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander gently catches her wrist mid-air, holding her hand firmly against his chest while looking into her eyes with solemn sincerity.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Solemn, Gentle)
events.content: "Not yet."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her eyes shining with quiet patience and understanding.

events.label: JULIANA (Sweet, Reassuring)
events.content: "Then I will wait."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Alexander releasing a quiet breath of gratitude, pulling her closer against his shoulder.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana rests her head against Alexander's collarbone once more, wrapping both arms around him as he cradles her head in his palm.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana's peaceful face resting against Alexander's rugged chest.

events.label: JULIANA (V.O.) (Reflective, Resonant)
events.content: "I know almost nothing about the man I married."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Slow pull-back wide shot of Alexander and Juliana locked in a tender, enduring embrace before the radiant, roaring hearth as the fire crackles peacefully.

events.label: JULIANA (V.O.) (Deeply Moved, Loving)
events.content: "But every day, he gives me another reason to trust him."

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Warm crackle of embers in the hearth blending with swelling, tender orchestral strings holding into the fade-out.

analysis_metadata.note: No invented LLM scene metadata; event-level evidence drives promo selection.
